Sergey on Instagram: "Netflix Q3 2025: Revenue Growth Holds Strong, But Margins Under Pressure?

Netflix delivered another quarter of robust top-line growth, posting $11.51B in revenue, up 17.2% YoY and 3.9% QoQ, just shy of estimates. The company guided Q4 revenue to $11.96B (+16.7% YoY), signaling continued momentum into 2026. Despite a one-time Brazilian tax charge, core results were solid, with strong engagement, expanding ad revenue, and steady free cash flow that supported ongoing buybacks.

The platform’s share of U.S. TV time climbed to 8.6%, up 1.1 percentage points YoY, and reached 9.4% in the U.K. according to Nielsen and BARB — both record highs. Regional performance showed broad strength: APAC up 21.3%, EMEA up 18.1%, and UCAN up 17.3% year-over-year. Meanwhile, the ad-supported tier continued to scale rapidly, positioning Netflix as a rising player in the global ad market. Management expects advertising revenue to more than double in 2025, driven by higher fill rates and the rollout of the new Netflix Ad Suite.

CFO Spence Neumann reaffirmed Netflix’s focus on “double-digit revenue growth, margin expansion, and increasing free cash flow,” signaling confidence in the company’s financial trajectory. Co-CEO Greg Peters emphasized innovation in AI-driven personalization and live-interactive experiences as key levers for engagement growth, while Ted Sarandos noted Netflix’s “enormous room for profitable growth” as it continues to capture share from traditional TV.

However, not all metrics were flawless. Earnings per share came in at $5.87, missing estimates by 14.9%, and margins compressed — gross margin at 46.4% (-1.5 pp YoY) and EBIT at 28.2% (-1.4 pp YoY). The question now: can Netflix sustain its pace of content investment and innovation while restoring profitability in 2026?

Overall, Netflix continues to prove its adaptability — expanding globally, leading in ad-supported streaming, and pushing deeper into live events, gaming, and interactivity. The fundamentals remain strong, and management’s tone suggests confidence that 2026 will mark another step forward in scaling its diversified entertainment ecosystem.

#Netflix #FinancialAnalysis #Earnings #NFLX"
